sourceMaterial.sourceEvidence: PO Ownership: Leading the Value Chain; Owning Product Portfolio Value. PO Trust: Executing Stakeholder Decisions; Building Stakeholder Confidence. PO System: Leading Product Ecosystems; Shaping Product Strategy.
sourceMaterial.relationshipLogic: PO behaviours may indicate strategic product leadership while Trust behaviours suggest decisions are strongly shaped by stakeholder direction or confidence-building. This may indicate a tension between product strategy ownership and the influence stakeholders have over product decisions.
